Subject: Jumpstart MAP: POC environment provisioning & peering handshake

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. I’m attaching a lightweight MAP workbook that outlines the recommended POC activation sequence so we can lock a concrete two-week runway. The places we need your confirmation on before we schedule work:

- Org setup: can you confirm the admin email we should use to onboard MedFrame org in our console?
- API keys: do you want scoped API keys (dev/test) or a global POC key? We recommend scoped keys for auditability.
- IP allowlist: Hannah will send our suggested egress IP ranges, please confirm which CIDR blocks you can whitelist.
- VPC peering: to avoid a maintenance window, we propose a peering window the week of Sep 27–29; Priyom can coordinate with your network team.

If that all looks good I’ll update the MAP timeline and send a DocuSign for the short POC terms (30 days, standard data handling). Draft MAP attached.

High-level timeline (proposal)
- Sep 14–17: org + API key provisioning, IP allowlist confirmation
- Sep 20–24: staging peering + smoke tests
- Sep 27–29: production peering window + acceptance

Open ask: please loop in your procurement contact if you anticipate any contract redlines.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Jumpstart MAP: POC environment provisioning & peering handshake

Hi Markus,

Thanks — the MAP looks good at first glance. A few quick notes from our side:

- Admin email: please use infra-admin@medframe.com for org setup.
- API keys: scoped keys preferred (dev/test) so our security team can audit per-environment usage.
- IP allowlist: I’ll confirm the CIDRs with our network team by EOD Sep 15.
- VPC peering: Sep 27–29 works in principle; I’ve cc’d procurement so they’re aware of any commercial steps.

Procurement: we’ll need SOC2 Type II evidence (summary OK for now) and a statement on data residency — MedFrame requires EU data processing.

If you can share the connectivity diagram and the exact egress ranges, I’ll route them internally. Happy to have an engineering touchpoint if required.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Infrastructure, MedFrame
Elena.Rossi@medframe.com
